result.answer:
Verdict: REFUTED

Holm step-down rejects 1 of the 4 hypotheses; the first two ordered thresholds are 0.0125 and 0.0167. The draft's claim of four corrected discoveries is not justified [S:b5f1303cd80f#2][S:bf11779879db#2][S:ec7c8fdcf586#2].

With m=4 and family alpha=0.05, the thresholds are 0.05/4=0.0125, 0.05/3≈0.0167, 0.05/2=0.025, and 0.05/1=0.05. H1 has p=0.0090, which is below 0.0125, so H1 is rejected. H2 has p=0.0190, which exceeds 0.0167, so the step-down procedure stops at the first failure and rejects only H1 [S:b5f1303cd80f#2][S:bf11779879db#2].

claims.text: The prespecified analysis treats four hypotheses as one family and applies Holm in ascending p-value order, comparing p(i) with alpha/(m-i+1) and stopping at the first failure, with family alpha 0.05.
claims.note: Span states exactly: one family of four, Holm ascending, alpha/(m-i+1), stop at first failure, family alpha 0.05.

claims.text: The reported ordered p-values are H1=0.0090, H2=0.0190, H3=0.0320, and H4=0.0495, and all four tests belong to the registered family.
claims.note: Span lists the four ordered p-values exactly and says all four tests belong to the registered family.

claims.text: With m=4 and family alpha=0.05, the first Holm ordered threshold is 0.0125 and the second is approximately 0.0167.
claims.note: With four hypotheses and alpha 0.05, the stated Holm formula yields 0.0125 then about 0.0167.

claims.text: H1 has p=0.0090, which is below the first threshold of 0.0125, so H1 is rejected.
claims.note: H1 p=0.0090 is below the derived first threshold 0.0125, so it is rejected under the stated procedure.

claims.text: H2 has p=0.0190, which exceeds the second threshold of approximately 0.0167, so the procedure stops at the first failure and rejects only one hypothesis.
claims.note: H2 p=0.0190 exceeds the derived second threshold about 0.0167, so Holm stops and only H1 is rejected.

claims.text: The draft asserts that every p-value is below 0.05 and therefore all four findings survive the registered multiple-comparison correction, while noting that it did not compute step-down thresholds.
claims.note: Span directly reports the draft asserted all p-values below 0.05, all four survive, and it did not compute step-down thresholds.
